name: The Whisperer in Darkness
source:
A brief interactive descent into Lovecraft’s The Whisperer in Darkness. Visit Akeley’s home and uncover the truth that drove him to madness.

[From [url=https://willskills9.itch.io/the-whisperer-in-darkness]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
简短互动地了解洛夫克拉夫特的《黑暗中的低语者》。拜访埃克利的家，揭开导致他疯狂的真相。

[来自[url=https://willskills9.itch.io/the-whisperer-in-darkness]Itch.io[/url]]
